items.heading: You Should Be Able
items.text: You Should Be Able You should be able to confirm you're speaking with a real, consistent person, not a rotating pool.

items.heading: Neither Format Is Automatically Better,
items.text: Neither format is automatically better, the real question is whether the four checks above hold up for the specific online process you're considering.

items.heading: A Video
items.text: A video-call session can look identical to a real one right up until you're on it. These four signs are about whether the online format itself was actually built with care, not bolted onto an in-person process as an afterthought.

items.heading: Ask Directly Whether a Session
items.text: Ask directly whether a session is a live two-way call or a recorded/scripted walkthrough before booking.

items.heading: Sensitive Personal and Family Information
items.text: Sensitive personal and family information deserves the same care online as it would in person, no unnecessary sharing, no pressure to over-disclose.

items.heading: Genuine Online
items.text: Genuine online-first delivery means the same quality regardless of which city or time zone you're in.
